snapshot.attribution: Source: U.S. General Services Administration, FY2026 per diem rates for the continental United States (CONUS).
validationReport: 346 CONUS destinations across 49 states and D.C., each with twelve monthly lodging caps.
48 per-state standard rates cover any locality GSA does not list separately.
159 destinations have seasonal lodging caps, so a trip is priced month by month.
M&IE totals resolve to 5 published tiers, each summing to its meal components.
Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories and foreign locations are not in this dataset. Those are set by DoD and the State Department, not GSA.
